original_idea.body: Run faithfulness battery at full/8-bit/4-bit precision; measure reveal-rate change.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: quantization is ubiquitous outside labs; if it degrades faithfulness, monitoring conclusions don't transfer.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: run identical battery at 3 precisions; quantization libs are standard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: same battery across 3 precision levels, fixed seeds.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, highly counterfactual (labs use full precision), public checkpoints.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference at quantized precisions on one model; single GPU, low-memory.
